title: Demand-weighted facility coverage on a constrained road network
prompt: Use fixtures/coverage-network.json to calculate 5-minute driving coverage from all facilities to every demand point. Use network time_minutes rather than Euclidean distance, assign each reachable demand to its least-cost facility with facility_id as the deterministic tie-break, retain every unreachable demand, and count population once even when multiple facilities cover it. Write outputs/demand-coverage.csv, outputs/service-gaps.geojson, and outputs/summary.json. Report the projected CRS, driving mode, cutoff, overlap population, unreachable demand, and demand-weighted coverage share explicitly.
invariants: Driving-network time rather than Euclidean distance determines coverage.
Demand covered by multiple facilities contributes population only once.
The deterministic assignment tie-break selects the lexical facility ID.
Every demand is reported, including the disconnected demand D7.
The projected EPSG:32636 CRS, five-minute cutoff, and driving mode remain explicit.
